commands: uv run harness fault calibrate --bank ~/aisle-private/fault-bank/v1/bank.json --clean-run runs/sfe-exposure-pilot-01 --clean-commit <clean_commit> --staging <outside-worktree> --raw-store ~/aisle-private/raw/fault-calibration --campaign-id flt-cal-v1 --output ~/aisle-private/fault-bank/v1/calibration-report.json

decision_rules.selection_rule: least severe rung whose paired clean-minus-fault difference is at least 0.25 with at least 3 discordant seed pairs and an exact 95% lower bound above 0.5 on the clean-only share of discordant pairs; sham must show parity

smallest_effect.measure: paired risk difference in episode success

decision_rules.stopping_rule: fixed 8 paired seeds per instance and severity; no severity added after seeing scored outcomes (FLT-10)

primary.aggregation: paired clean-minus-fault difference with exact interval

secondary.aggregation: does the typed evidence bundle contain a component-level signal

exclusions.deviation_policy: any behaviour-affecting change after registration is a documented deviation record and a new campaign version id; confirmatory data never revises the registered protocol
infrastructure: dora launch failure before the first turn
watchdog expiry attributable to host load (host-load baseline retained)
exclusions.rerun_policy: a permitted rerun receives a new randomized id; the original row is retained with its exclusion reason and never replaced in place
treatment_integrity: fault identity visible in any participant-facing surface (FLT-4)

hypotheses.statement: Each candidate fault instance degrades the paired clean baseline episode success by at least the minimum meaningful degradation while leaving localizable evidence (FLT-9).
Sham (no-fault) controls are indistinguishable from the clean baseline at session start and in outcome (FLT-8).

instrument_set.note: instance ids, severities, and bytes are sealed outside the worktree (FLT-4); only families and their commitments are public

integrity_checks.owner_role: harness fault validate (private manifest; commitment tracked)
calibration report (sham at parity observed; the FLT-8 leakage probe classifier is not built)

seed_commitment.rule: calibration seeds are the retained clean run's development seeds 0..7 (excluded_pilot); held-out assignment seeds for scoring are separate and sealed

superseded: flt-bank-calibration-v1 (registered before the injector and bank existed)
